Trace, implement and test: First Occurance In String

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class FirstOccuranceInString {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String one="sahil";
        String two="sa";
        System.out.println(strStr(one,two));
    }
    public static int strStr(String haystack, String needle) {
        if(haystack.contains(needle)){
            return haystack.indexOf(needle);
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
